about:
Founded in 1961, Northern Illinois Steel Supply Co. has been based in Channahon, Illinois for over six decades. The company operates an 80,000-square-foot facility that combines warehousing and fabrication under one roof, and it supports regional customers through additional offices in Chicago and Houston, Texas.

The company’s product line focuses on domestic steel, offering aluminum, stainless steel, plates, sheets, structural shapes, bars, tubing, and grating. It complements its inventory with custom precision fabrication services, allowing customers to source both raw material and finished components from a single supplier.

Northern Illinois Steel Supply serves a customer base concentrated in Illinois and Indiana, with its Channahon headquarters acting as the primary distribution and fabrication hub. The Chicago and Texas offices extend its sales reach, though the company does not disclose specific industry sectors or major accounts.

The company attributes its longevity to responsive service and a highly skilled workforce, stating that its strength lies in delivering high-quality products and responsive service. It also cites its state-of-the-art equipment and fully stocked domestic steel inventory as factors that set it apart.

name: Northern Wire
old_description: Northern Wire specializes in manufacturing complex wire forms and assorted components that are critical in a wide range of applications. Our wire processing capabilities extend up to 12 feet, which gives us the flexibility to meet a variety of material demands. We offer resistance and wire feed welding capabilities and have 25 presses with a capacity of 10 to 600 tons to flatten, punch, and stake.
about:
Northern Wire operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Merrill, Wisconsin. Established in 1970, the company has grown into one of the country's largest custom wire-forming operations and now operates as part of the MW Components family, the largest single-source supplier of specialty fasteners in the nation.

The company manufactures complex wire forms, specialty bends, and welded products with wire processing capabilities extending up to 12 feet. Its shop runs 25 presses ranging from 10 to 600 tons for flattening, punching, and staking, plus resistance and wire-feed welding. Northern Wire combines automated CNC wire bending with manual forming to handle geometries that automation alone cannot achieve, and it performs a full suite of secondary operations in house — including chamfering, coining, drilling, extruding, grooving, knurling, machining, piercing, tapping, and threading — alongside standalone zinc plating and powder coating services.

Northern Wire serves original equipment manufacturers and blue-chip wholesalers and distributors across aerospace, agriculture, appliances, construction, consumer goods, energy, industrial, lawn and garden, medical, power equipment, and recreation markets. Its blended sourcing model pairs domestic quality control with licensed product manufacturing and design consultation to mitigate supply-chain disruptions.

The company emphasizes engineering excellence and quality at all levels, holding ISO 9001:2015 certification and QSLM Class 2 compliance with tools calibrated and traceable to NIST. In-house secondary services and a barcode-driven distribution system are cited as key factors in reducing lead times for time-sensitive deliveries.

name: Northland Auto & Truck Accessories
old_description: Northland Automotive is a full-service accessories shop located in Billings Montana. We are a family owned and operated business that has been around for over 40 years. We have a very knowledgeable staff that have well over 150 years of combined industry experience. We have 4 full time shop technicians that install everything we sell. We offer a very wide variety of products from the top manufactures in the industry. We have over 100 manufactures that we can choose from, and we only sell the best rated products available. Northland Automotive has over a 15,000 sq ft. warehouse with a complete inventory of products in stock. We realize we can't stock every product, so we have agreements with other vendors and warehouses that we can pull product & parts from in order to service our customers in a timely manner.
about:
Northland Auto & Truck Accessories operates from Billings, Montana, where it has served the region for over 40 years as a family-owned and operated business. The company was founded by the current ownership group, though specific founders are not named in public records.

The shop stocks and installs a broad range of aftermarket accessories for pickup trucks and SUVs, drawing on relationships with more than 100 manufacturers. Its 15,000-square-foot warehouse carries a deep inventory of parts ranging from air intakes and lighting to bed covers, bumpers, and winches. Four full-time technicians handle installation of every product sold, including spray-in bedliners, truck toppers, running boards, and grille guards. The staff collectively holds over 150 years of industry experience.

Northland primarily serves individual truck and SUV owners in Montana and surrounding areas, as well as commercial fleets needing upfit solutions. Customers include recreational off-road enthusiasts seeking suspension lifts and lighting from brands like Rigid Industries and Baja Designs, contractors requiring fiberglass or work-style truck toppers, and drivers needing animal-strike protection with full front bumpers and grille guards from Ranch Hand and Go Rhino.

The company emphasizes adherence to every manufacturer’s warranty and installation guidelines, and it supplements its own stock with vendor agreements to source hard-to-find parts quickly. Its guiding principle, captured in the slogan “Sell Everything But The Truck!,” reflects a commitment to being a one-stop shop for truck and SUV accessories backed by professional installation.

name: Northwind Solar
old_description: Northwind Solar is a full-service solar electric system provider specializing in everything you need to make your solar PV installation successful, including site evaluation, system design, incentive application and grant writing, utility interconnection, permitting, installation, and system commissioning. Our installations are led by our NABCEP-certified installers and licensed electricians. Since 2007, we have successfully installed megawatts of small-scale, distributed solar generation.
about:
Northwind Solar was established in 2007 in Amherst, Wisconsin. In 2013 the company transitioned to a worker‑owned cooperative, meaning the technicians and designers who install each system are also the owners of the business. The cooperative model was adopted to align long‑term company health with customer success.

The firm provides turnkey solar photovoltaic and battery storage solutions for residential, commercial, agricultural, nonprofit, and municipal customers across 19 counties in Central Wisconsin. Its in‑house team handles site evaluation, shade analysis, system design, financial modeling, incentive and grant applications (including Focus on Energy and USDA REAP), utility interconnection, permitting, installation, commissioning, and ongoing service. Installations are performed by NABCEP‑credentialed designers and licensed electricians, and the company has deployed megawatts of distributed solar generation since its founding.

Customers range from homeowners and family farms to businesses, schools, faith communities, and local government facilities in communities such as Wausau, Marshfield, Stevens Point, Appleton, and Oshkosh. Projects include rooftop and ground‑mount arrays, solar‑plus‑storage systems, EV charging infrastructure, and energy monitoring platforms.

Northwind Solar differentiates itself through its worker‑owned structure, which eliminates commissioned sales and ensures the same personnel support a system years after installation. The company backs its work with a 10‑year workmanship warranty, uses components from brands such as Tesla, Qcells, IronRidge, Enphase, and Franklin Whole Home, and relies heavily on referrals and repeat business.

name: Nova Medical Inc
old_description: Nova Medical is a world renowned manufacturer of a wide variety of state-of-the-art medium and high field RF products.
about:
Nova Medical Inc. is headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts. The company originated from Dr. Patrick Ledden’s five years of experience designing and building custom radiofrequency (RF) coils for Massachusetts General Hospital. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in engineering and manufacturing medium- and high-field RF coils for magnetic resonance imaging, including head coils and custom configurations. Its roughly 10,000-square-foot facility contains a dedicated RF laboratory, design workstations running AutoCAD and SolidWorks, and 3D printing equipment for prototyping and production. Employee count and annual output are not disclosed.

Nova Medical serves the medical imaging sector, supplying coils to hospitals and research institutions. Its earliest customer, Massachusetts General Hospital, exemplifies the academic medical centers that rely on its custom coil solutions for advanced MRI research and clinical applications.

The company was established to translate Dr. Ledden’s coil expertise into commercial products that address specific MR imaging challenges. It emphasizes in-house design, testing, and manufacturing to deliver high-quality coils tailored to each application.

name: NovelCath A Cirtec Company
old_description: In July 2021, NovelCath’s parent company, Cirtec Medical, acquired Cardea Catheter Innovations, a vertically integrated manufacturer of minimally invasive catheter devices and complex delivery systems based in San Jose, CA.  Cardea will integrate within the NovelCath brand, contributing to Cirtec’s Interventional segment focusing on structural heart, electrophysiology, and neurovascular applications.
about:
NovelCath, a Cirtec Medical company, operates from Minneapolis, Minnesota. The brand was strengthened in July 2021 when Cirtec acquired Cardea Catheter Innovations, a vertically integrated manufacturer of minimally invasive catheter devices based in San Jose, California, and folded its operations into the NovelCath name. The business focuses on the design, development, and manufacture of highly engineered catheter delivery systems for interventional medicine.

The company runs a 20,000-square-foot vertically integrated facility that houses clean-room assembly, dedicated prototyping lines, catheter assembly, extrusion, braiding, coiling, and multiple reflow technologies. Recent expansion added Nitinol processing capabilities including laser cutting, heat setting, electropolishing, EDM, 5-axis machining, and grinding. The engineering team supports customers from early-stage concept verification through animal studies and into production, emphasizing long-term manufacturability.

NovelCath serves medical-device OEMs and start-ups in three clinical areas: structural heart, electrophysiology, and neurovascular. Its product portfolio includes EP mapping and ablation catheters, structural heart valve delivery and repair systems, steerable multi-directional catheters, and neuro microcatheters. The company also produces braided and coiled reinforced sheaths, offering a range of braid patterns, wire types, and durometer configurations tailored to torque, flexibility, and tip-articulation requirements.

NovelCath differentiates itself through its vertically integrated Nitinol tubing and processing services, quick-turn prototyping, and a leadership team with over 70 years of combined experience solving complex steerable and multi-directional catheter shaft designs. As a division of Cirtec Medical, it leverages broader organizational resources while maintaining a focused, responsive approach to catheter development.

name: O'Meara Solar
old_description: Reduce, or eliminate, your monthly electric bills. We can design a system for your home that will meet your yearly usage needs, and save you money. With electricity rates rising around 2.5% per year, the fixed cost of a grid-tied solar PV system is a great investment for the future. With standard loan products available locally, a system can pay for itself in as little as ten years, and you can enjoy having very little if any electricity bills for at least the next 15 years
about:
O'Meara Solar is based in East Orange, Vermont. The company was founded as a father-son partnership between Darren O'Meara and Patrick O'Meara after they spent the better part of a decade installing, maintaining, and living with solar energy in their own homes and woodworking shop.

The firm designs, sells, installs, and services grid-tie, off-grid, and grid-tie-with-battery-backup solar photovoltaic systems. It also operates a solar-powered woodworking shop where it builds custom enclosures, cabinets, furniture, and built-ins using locally sustainably harvested wood. The company is commercially insured and draws on a network of master electricians and concrete professionals for structural work.

O'Meara Solar serves residential customers in Orange County, Vermont, and Grafton County, New Hampshire, as well as surrounding areas. Its off-grid systems are designed for remote homes and cabins, accommodating 120/240 V loads such as deep-well pumps and shop tools. The woodworking side produces custom pieces for the same regional clientele.

The business grew directly from the founders' personal off-grid lifestyle; Darren O'Meara holds a NABCEP Photovoltaic EL certification and handles electrical design, while Patrick O'Meara brings over thirty years of construction and fine woodworking experience. The company says this hands-on experience with the systems they sell is what sets its designs apart.

name: OAI Electronics Inc
old_description: At OAI our diverse management team and highly experienced production personnel comprise the predictable, competitive and qualified workforce behind OAI Electronics LLC.
about:
OAI Electronics operates from Tulsa, Oklahoma, where it runs two environmentally monitored facilities totaling 65,000 square feet. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, describing its workforce as a diverse management team and highly experienced production personnel.

As a build-to-print contract electronics manufacturer, OAI produces circuit card assemblies, flex and rigid-flex assemblies, and electromechanical enclosures. Its capabilities span surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, RF boards, high-temperature assemblies, potting, encapsulation, conformal coating, and system integration, all performed to IPC-A-610 and IPC J-STD-001 Classes 2 and 3.

The company serves the aerospace, military, medical, and industrial sectors, with its ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certification scope explicitly covering printed circuit board assemblies and box builds for those markets.

OAI emphasizes a predictable, competitive, and qualified workforce, blending skilled employees, proven processes, continual improvement, and responsive systems to deliver products on time and to customer specifications. It maintains in-house IPC-certified trainers and complies with NIST 800-171 for controlled unclassified information.

about:
Based in Houston, Texas, OEM Components Inc has spent five decades supplying high-performance sealing technology to the oil and gas industry. The company was established as a manufacturer of original equipment components, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures machined components, high-technology specialty seals, and related oilfield product designs, with a focus on surface and subsurface drilling and completion seal systems. OEM pioneered and patented ECNER wire mesh sealing technology and holds several design patents. It also provides seal design, component and product engineering, and turn-key manufacturing services including engineering design and supply, sub-assemblies, and complete assemblies built to customer drawings and specifications.

OEM serves the oil and gas industry, providing sealing solutions for aggressive downhole conditions and high-temperature, high-pressure (HTHP) applications. Its customer base includes operators and contractors requiring reliable sealing systems for drilling and completion operations.

The company emphasizes design innovation, reliability, and quality, backed by a stable supply base secured through broad industry contacts.
